def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    rem = bins - item
    valid = rem >= 0
    max_cap = np.max(bins)
    used = max_cap - bins
    fill_ratio = np.where(max_cap > 0, used / max_cap, 0.0)
    avg_fill = np.mean(fill_ratio[used > 0]) if np.any(used > 0) else 0.0
    scores = np.where(valid, -np.exp(rem / max_cap) + fill_ratio, -np.inf)
    empty_mask = (bins == max_cap) & valid
    if np.any(empty_mask):
        first_empty = np.argmax(empty_mask)
        scores[first_empty] = -1.5 - avg_fill
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    rem = bins - item
    valid = rem >= 0
    max_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 else 1.0
    used = max_cap - bins
    active = used > 0
    mean_used = np.mean(used[active]) if np.any(active) else 0.0
    var_penalty = -np.abs(used - mean_used) / max_cap
    fit_score = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(rem / max_cap * 5.0))
    scores = np.where(valid, fit_score + var_penalty, -np.inf)
    empty = (bins == max_cap) & valid
    if np.any(empty):
        first_empty = np.argmax(empty)
        scores[first_empty] = 0.1 - (np.sum(active) / len(bins))
    return scores
